requests.subject: Adding a rule/exception to required number of parent contacts
requests.details: For safeguarding, the schools need to enforce the collection of 2 parents (not just 2 contacts, 2 parents specifically) - most of their parents are able to comply. For parents who cannot comply due to circumstances such as death of parent, they need to manually change the required parent contacts to 1, allow the parent to complete the form, and then change their settings back to 2.
requests.impact: Manual solution currently in place; schools has to change settings, and the parent has to contact the school to request help proceeding to the next step - their current process disrupts parents' completion of the form.
requests.solution: Adding a function to allow parents to skip adding a second parent, only if they are able to upload supporting evidence eg death certificate. Flow suggested: 2 parents always required. If a parent is unable to provide a second parental contact, they have an option to select why they cannot provide more details, and have to upload supporting evidence, and in completing this they can then proceed to complete the rest of the form with only 1 set of details provided.

requests.subject: Limit number of selectable subjects from a defined list
requests.details: Currently, when students are making their selections across option blocks, there is no way to restrict how many subjects they can choose from a specific group.
requests.solution: Introduce a rule that allows schools to define a maximum number of selections from a specified group of subjects, regardless of the blocks they are in. This could be configurable within the Options setup as something like: “Maximum number of subjects selectable from this group”

requests.subject: Adding more context on selecting primary contacts on Parent/Carer Step
requests.details: At the moment, the system is telling the parent the significance of the primary contact under the "i" icon. Most parents uses phones in the system, and may not view this description, making them miss the vital information that they need to know for the particular bit.
requests.impact: Parents tend to miss vital information, who to tag as primary contact (that goes to the school's MIS), and schools have to then manually input this to their MIS, and spend more time rather than save time using A+
requests.solution: By allowing the system to add more instruction/description on this particular section, this should allow schools to ensure parents are informed properly and gather more essential information from the parents

requests.subject: Date of birth range
requests.details: At the moment the child date of birth range does not apply when the parent creates a registration
requests.impact: Does not restrict parents who do not meet the birth range for their child.
requests.solution: (optional): allow date of birth range to be applied for parent registration form

requests.subject: Transition Tool
requests.details: School is requesting to make it possible for transition tool question to be visible in the Meeting Areas as a Filter for adding students, and to show on the meeting notes.
requests.impact: When meeting with Year 7 parents, it would be great for Staff members to see information about their transition data along side the admission form
requests.solution: (optional): Allow option to add transition tool data in the  Meeting notes Attachment: No

requests.subject: Pin/freeze classes only
requests.details: Currently, pinning a class freezes the class in place, but also the allocated students. What they would like is the ability to freeze the class in place, but to allow the students to be redistributed to other groups if they re-run their allocation - they want an option to freeze the class, but leave the students unfrozen.
requests.solution: Add an option to pin class and students, or just class

requests.subject: Export or report for individual student learning hours
requests.details: Schools need to ensure students will meet the required number of learning hours based on courses chosen and are currently having to check this manually in a spreadsheet outside of Applicaa
requests.solution: Add to the existing reports in Options (GCSE) to show learning hours (per subject and total) on the "students' allocations" report

requests.subject: Start Application Button on Parent Homepage
requests.details: Currently, the system does not allow the school to disable the Start New Application button on the parent homepage specifically for Year 7, without also affecting other admission forms—such as, but not limited to, the Musical Aptitude form. At present, when the Year 7 setting is turned off, it automatically disables the button for all forms with the Year 7 type
requests.solution: Implement a setting that enables the school to disable the Start New Application button for a specific form, without impacting other forms

requests.subject: Hard Stop Validation for Parental Responsibility
requests.details: Currently, the form allows a user to proceed and submit even if they have not designated at least one contact with Parental Responsibility. During testing, Hampstead School found a loophole where a user can add a contact, select "No" for PR, and still successfully submit the form. The system does not currently verify that at least one person in the contact list holds legal parental responsibility even if this question is required, if parent says no to all contacts, then theres no PR added.
requests.impact: Without this "Hard Stop," admissions officers have to manually email parents, ask for the information, and update the record themselves. This defeats the purpose of an automated digital form.
requests.solution: Implement a "Hard Stop" or validation rule identical to the existing Priority 1 Contact block. The form should prevent the user from moving to the next step or submitting the form unless the "Parental Responsibility" toggle is set to "Yes" for at least one contact.

requests.subject: Improve postcode selection
requests.details: Force that parents/students must either select a registered postcode from the lookup or alternatively click to say they can't find their postcode so that they can then manually input it. A College described to me that they had 700 applicants where the distance measure tool wasnt working as students had been allowed to manually type their address and not forced to select the address look up, so they had to impersonate 700 students and complete this task manually
requests.impact: Users
requests.solution: (optional): Make it mandatory to select a postcode or alternatively that they 'cant find their address' allowing them to then type it in

requests.subject: Meetings Area: option for a "Virtual Meeting: set up inside A+
requests.details: Allow school to create meetings in the meetings area where they can set it up as a "Virtual Meeting" aside from in person (usual meetings)
requests.impact: Providing this feature would allow parents to be able to attend meetings without leaving work for a day etc. Also for school to hold and accomplish more meetings
requests.solution: Add an option to create a meeting and allocate students/parents but in a "Virtual Meeting" setting

requests.subject: Remove description box for consents
requests.details: The description box on the A+ system gives a false sense of capability for the school that lets them add blurb/information about the consent the parents are allowing for the students. This causes confusion for the school staff who edits these area, as this gets removed when the daily Cloud MIS sync happens. Apparently, school admins have been adding information on the
requests.impact: Avoid unnecessary workload for the school admin, and issues with what they enter on the system (what parents sees on the form), by removing this the admin will not enter anything on A+ about the description of the consents, and will always have to update it on their MIS first, and A+ will then just copy whatever is on their MIS.
requests.solution: Completely remove the description box for consents

requests.subject: Private Link for Events
requests.details: Bute House has requested for events if they could have private links, so if links are shared with others they cannot register to it. Is this possible? We can only see Public link or Enquiry link
requests.impact: They only invite the Registered families to this event and if they share this public link to other people then this affects the safety of their students and also safeguarding concerns in general. It should only be the parents that have been invited to the event that should attend and no one else.
requests.solution: (optional): Make it into a private link only and only the email associated to that invitation to register for this event should be able to register for this event only and no one else.

requests.subject: Enable Fixed Timetables for Taster Days
requests.details: The school would like the ability to upload or assign a fixed timetable to a Taster Day. Currently, students are required to manually select their sessions, but in this school's case, the sessions are already pre-assigned. They only need the student to log in and confirm their attendance for their specific assigned slots. Because the Taster Day feature doesn't support this set-up, the school has deleted the Taster Day phase entirely. They are planning to use the Events feature as a workaround, treating "tickets" as session confirmations just to track who is attending.
requests.impact: Providing this feature would allow schools with pre-set schedules to use the Taster Day feature as intended.
requests.solution: Add a toggle or import option within the Taster Day feature that allows admins to assign a fixed timetable to a student.

requests.subject: Exporting to PDF
requests.details: Exams+ School needs to print desk labels for students sitting an exam, when exporting to PDF at the moment there are hard coded data that appears on the PDF. We also can only print 100 profiles at a time which will take alot of time for a exams+ school that has couple thousands of students
requests.impact: can't use export to PDF at the moment to use for printing desk labels because it has unnecessary data, or data that they simply can't display on desk due to data privacy.
requests.solution: (optional): No

requests.subject: Enable "Reset" functionality for Offers in "Offer Made" status.
requests.details: Currently, the "Reset" option (introduced to allow staff to amend Offer details) is only available once an Offer moves to the "Accepted" status. Staff users, frequently need to adjust Bill Payer Percentage settings or other offer-specific details after the offer is generated. It is common that parents change their minds or makes mistake after completing a step in the Offer phase.
requests.impact: This affects the workflow of school's admissions. The current workaround creates inaccurate audit trails (showing a parent accepted when they didn't) and adds unnecessary administrative steps. Allowing staff users reset during the "Offer Made" phase ensures parents have entered the correct details before the Offer Contract is generated and sent to them.
requests.solution: Update the visibility of the "Reset" button so that it is available whenever the Offer status is "Offer Made" or "Accepted". This would allow staff to jump back to the Bill Payer or other Offer steps without needing to change the student's status first.

requests.subject: Automated event cancellation emails cannot be edited or customised
requests.details: When an open event is cancelled, the system sends a generic automated email that cannot be edited. The college had no way to include the reason for cancellation (an Ofsted visit), forcing them to send a separate manual email beforehand, followed by the unhelpful generic one.
requests.impact: Creates a poor applicant experience (receiving two contradictory or confusing emails), adds manual administrative overhead, and risks reputational damage when the college can't communicate professionally through the system.
requests.solution: Allow users to edit the body of automated cancellation emails before they are sent, or provide a customisable template field where a reason/context can be inserted at the point of cancellation.

requests.subject: Exporting to PDF
requests.area: Data Import/Export, Post Enrolment (TT, CTF, SH)
requests.details: School wants to be able to export students transition tool data into PDF similar to how it is when you export application form into PDF
requests.impact: allows schools to print transition tool data
requests.solution: (optional): Add option to export transition tool data to PDF

requests.subject: Add Note for School Name Field
requests.details: Users can only select a school from a dropdown list, which may not include all schools. Bute House has requested the addition of an instructional note in the Child’s Details section, specifically for the school name field. To improve usability, they would like to add a note before the field with the wording:
requests.impact: This enhancement will provide clearer guidance to users and help reduce confusion when the school is not available in the list and incomplete form submissions

requests.subject: BCC PARENTS
requests.details: a school has raised a concern following feedback from a parent regarding email privacy. Currently, our process appears to use CC for these communications, and the school has asked if it's possible to hide parent email addresses from one another—particularly in cases where parents are separated.
requests.impact: updating the logic to BCC would be the best solution to ensure data privacy, as we are likely to see many more cases like this
requests.solution: (optional): update the option to BCC Parents instead of CC

requests.subject: PDF wording
requests.details: For questions which are not asked on application form, the ability not to show them on the PDF export would be helpful. Also, if a question is not asked, don't show the answer as "no", but rather as "not collected".
requests.impact: currently misleading to have unused fields showing on the PDF, and likewise displaying "no" as a default response (makes parents and schools think they have chosen a response, when they haven't)
requests.solution: (optional): as above.

requests.subject: system built-in documents editor
requests.details: Schools would usually have other forms or documents such as that they would like parents to complete further to the admission or enrolment form. At the moment there is no easy way to incorporate this and they are having to do this outside the system. It would be great to have a feature that allows to edit attached documents.
requests.impact: instead of schools asking parents to download a word document or pdf and parents completing these forms outside the system and returning it back to the school office, we can potentially have all forms and documents completed and compiled in our system.
requests.solution: (optional): implement an area on the application form or connected to, that allows it to open documents, edit it and submit it within the application form.

requests.subject: Standardize event display limits across all landing page themes
requests.details: Currently, the "Landing Page 2" theme restricts the display of events to a maximum of two, even when more events (e.g., three or more) are active in the system. When switching to the "Default Landing Page," all created events display correctly. Users expect consistent behavior regardless of the visual theme they have selected.
requests.impact: This creates confusion for schools who believe their events are not saving or publishing correctly. It limits the visibility of important school dates.
requests.solution: (optional): Update the logic for "Landing Page 2" to match the "Default" theme, allowing all events to be visible, or add a configuration setting to let the school choose the number of events displayed.

requests.subject: Start New Application in Parent Homepage
requests.details: Currently when you have the new application button enabled on the parent homepage it is visible to all parents of all application forms
requests.impact: This causes a lot of confusion among parents, for example a Year 7 parent tend to click on the start new application button creating a duplicate student or application for another year group which they do not intend to do.
requests.solution: (optional): Have the option to hide the start new application button on the parent homepage of a specific application form.

requests.subject: Allow different phone number formats per phone type (Home/Work/Mobile)
requests.details: Currently, the phone format validation in the form builder applies the same format to all phone types (Home, Work, Mobile). Schools have requested the ability to set different formats depending on the phone type selected. One Phone Format setting applies to all phone numbers entered through that question
requests.impact: will allow schools to set different formats per phone type, to save them time with data-cleansing tasks
requests.solution: Allow separate format validation for Home phone (e.g., XXX-XXXX-XXXX for landlines), Work phone (e.g., XXX-XXXX-XXXX for landlines), Mobile phone (e.g., XXXXX-XXXXXX for mobiles)

requests.subject: Auto-grouping applicants based on question responses (e.g., boarding, grammar school preferences)
Bespoke Candidate Sheets for Grammar School Entrance Tests
Taster Day tracking
requests.details: Staff are only able to see whether a student attended their Taster Day under the timetables and submissions screen, but they want to be able to cross-reference this with other statuses eg the ability to build a tile on the dashboard to show "taster day attended & offer accepted". Would also be useful to have a taster day tile on student profiles (like application status etc) to show pending/registered/attended. There is also currently no way to filter the "attended" students to send a follow-up email after the event.
requests.impact: Staff can more easily track taster day attendance and refer to it alongside other statuses/apply filters like they can for application, meeting, offer and enrolment phases

requests.subject: "Details to be checked" feature on Year 7 Form
Staff-level pathways
requests.details: Currently, staff are able to mis-enrol students into the wrong pathways. See video - they do not want students to be restricted by pathway, but want the restrictions to apply at staff level instead. Example: a student passes the general entry requirements, but does not have the right combination of grades to study the 4 A Level pathway. Currently, this relies on staff knowledge and interpretation to only enrol the student to 3 subjects.
requests.impact: Would mean they can have more staff confidently helping them with enrolment procedures, without needing to know or refer to specific pathway requirements (system would just show who does/does not qualify for each pathway)
requests.solution: (optional): Ability to have a pathway level restriction for staff only (like "restrict enrolment by teachers", but at pathway level rather than subject level)

requests.subject: Extra status for offers
requests.details: Some providers (those oversubscribed, and also colleges) may elect not to make offers to some applicants. Currently, they just have to leave them as "offer pending", but this would potentially be a combination of those deliberately not being made an offer, and those who have just not had an offer made to them yet.
requests.impact: Will allow schools/colleges to distinguish between different categories of offer - offer pending, vs no offer being made
requests.solution: (optional): Extra status - "no offer" (with equivalent template) to make clear those who are not being offered a place, vs those who have just not been met/discussed yet

requests.subject: Extra status for enrolment
requests.details: Splitting "enrolment waiting" into 2 separate statuses will allow schools and colleges to distinguish between those who are enrolled elsewhere, or those where a decision is deferred for another reason (for example the school can offer a place, but not for the subjects the student chose). Currently, "enrolment waiting" would hold both applicants, although their reasons for being in that "holding" status would be different.
requests.impact: Will allow schools/colleges to distinguish between different categories of pending enrolees
requests.solution: (optional): Extra status - something like "considering revised offer", so schools can keep "enrolment waiting" purely for those who are enrolled elsewhere

requests.subject: Update MIS logo labels
requests.details: Staff currently see fields (particularly for Bromcom) which have Bromcom logos, but are not fields which are in use/able to be written back to - example is "dietary needs" property. Would request that we update the fields on all Bromcom systems - all fields that we don't use anymore should not have the logo
requests.impact: This will significantly reduce visual clutter and improve clarity for Bromcom customers (and us!)

requests.subject: Customizable "Phase Status" View to Reduce Visual Noise
requests.details: Staff currently see all possible status categories (e.g., Awaiting Reference, Deadline Missed, Skipped Payment Step) even when they are irrelevant or contain zero entries. Hampstead School is requesting the ability to hide or toggle off specific status rows.
requests.impact: This will significantly reduce visual clutter - by allowing staff to focus only on actionable and relevant statuses.

requests.subject: Change field type and/or remove unused code
requests.details: Sometimes a school adds a field and then changes their mind about what format they'd like. They don't currently have the ability to change from a text input to a dropdown single select, for example. Currently they have to delete the field, and then add it again in the desired format. As a follow-on to this, there is no way currently to delete the code associated to the "wrong" field. For example, if they created a text input field, and then deleted it and added a new field in another format, the code they used for the text input would already have been taken, showing an error. This causes issues when creating filters or adding mail merge tokens to emails, as it becomes harder to know which is the correct version to add. Suggestion: when deleting a field, offer the option to delete the code as well.
requests.impact: Will keep properties list tidier, and make schools' lives easier by not having to recreate fields, but rather just be able to change their format.

requests.subject: Update instructions (wording) on parent/carer step
requests.details: could cause confusion with current wording. This makes it sound like every contact must provide an email address, work number etc whereas actually what we're saying is that each time a value is provided, it needs to be unique - suggest "where an email address is required, this must be unique per contact (no shared email addresses permitted)"
requests.impact: It will avoid confusion for parents

requests.subject: Offer courses column in Subject Summary
requests.details: Currently there is no column for offer courses subjects, it will be much easier to monitor if that is included on the table
requests.impact: It will be much easier to track the offered subjects to students and they can compare it with the application form interested subjects on the same table.

requests.subject: Court Order for all contacts
requests.details: Currently the court order section in the parent carer step of the application form applies to all contacts.
requests.impact: Schools would not usually ask for court order for additional contacts and so it would be good to have an option for schools to control which type of contacts they want to ask the court order for.

requests.subject: Multiple Dropdown option for Medical Practice Information (Bromcom)
requests.details: Currently, when providing medical information, all details have to be manually typed. It would be much easier to have a dropdown selection that pulls the list from Bromcom, as Bromcom already uses a multi-select dropdown for this data.
requests.impact: If parents enter the GP name with incorrect spelling, it creates duplicate entries in Bromcom. Implementing this feature would reduce staff workload by minimizing the need to check for and delete extra GP information.

requests.subject: Import Subjects to Blocks
requests.details: when importing subjects of students it does not automatically go into the assigned option block
requests.impact: this creates a significant admin tasks for staff members as they have to individually select the corresponding blocks for each student after the import.

requests.subject: Meeting slots
requests.details: currently there is no bulk way to create multiple same timeslots in one meeting date and be able to assign to different staff members. e.g. if i wanted a 5 10am slots assigned to different staff members, I have to manually add 4 additional slots or create 5 different meeting dates for each staff member.
requests.impact: would save a lot of time in creating meetings.

requests.subject: Clear notifications
requests.details: The number 79 shows over the bell icon, but when you click on the bell, there is no indication of what the 79 relates to, or a way to mark them as read/clear the notifications
requests.impact: currently, makes staff think they have an outstanding action to complete (would be better to have this number clearable after clicking

requests.subject: Copy settings from previous cycle
requests.details: Customisations made on 25/26 forms (eg questions on TT, customisation of email sent to primary schools) do not copy over from the previous year, so schools are having to replicate their settings manually each cycle.
requests.impact: Decreases manual duplication of work already completed on old forms

requests.subject: Default Email Templates for Students  -  Example: New Password email template in all Indie A+ system
requests.type: Allow to change the Target Audience that are default to students
requests.details: Indies process is for the parents to create enquiry, application and all relevant steps in the journey for their child. However, there are some default email templates that are Default to Students which are also essential for parents to be receiving.  A good example is the New Password email template. Although we can change the content to update it to parent's tokens. Still, schools are finding it contradicting as the targeted audience or recipient is "default to Student". So I think, the ability for the Indie CSM's and School Staffs to be able to amend all emails default to students to be changed to target Parents as recipient.
requests.impact: This will allow CSMs and schools to efficiently update communications area in making sure that essential emails like this are sent accordingly.

requests.subject: Two-way communication hub (emails, SMS replies into Admissions+)
requests.solution: Tim confirmed this is already on roadmap and should be released before next meeting (late March). Starting with:

requests.subject: Recent Applications view in the main dashboard
requests.details: While there is a setting on the Recent Applications view in the main dashboard that can show details of Recent Applications and to what specific step of the phase the applicant is, it only shows 10 most recent. School wanted to be able to show all applications with each phase and to what step the applicant is.
requests.impact: This will allow schools to efficiently track so they can already predict and send communications to who ever they need to contact.

requests.subject: Automated Confirmation Email for Referees
requests.details: School is looking for a way to send an automated email to referee to confirm their completion of the reference area but there is no option to do that.
requests.impact: Decreases manual follow-up emails from referees asking if their form went through, and serves as a courtesy to thank them for doing their part.
requests.productTeamNote: Feature to provide and edit Confirmation message after referee completes the form already exist within the reference configuration page.

requests.subject: Export "Best Subjects" Data
requests.details: While there is a setting on the Application Form that can currently calculate the highest grades, there is no way to export this specific data. Currently, staff can only export the total APS or the individual predicted grades for every subject. This creates manual workload, as staff must manually cross-reference and identify the "best" subjects based on all of the predicted grades that student has added.
requests.impact: This will allow schools to efficiently track and report on top-performing subjects without manual data manipulation.

requests.subject: FAQs button
requests.details: Currently you can only have the FAQ button if you have registrations on in the landing page configuration, while there is an option to disable registration there is no option to hide it and still be able to see the FAQ button.
requests.impact: Ideally the FAQ button will be the only visible button for them in the new application block.

requests.subject: Apply setting changes for all
requests.details: Currently, if a school has applied settings in this area and then makes offers to students, any changes they make (such as extending the deadline) will only apply to those who are made an offer after the change is implemented. It would be helpful to have options: apply to future offers or apply to all offers
requests.impact: Means the schools can decide to whom any changes would apply, and can maintain control of their enrolment process

requests.subject: Option to customise view and apply for all
requests.details: For the Overview and Meetings tabs on a student profile it is possible to customise the view, but this currently has to be completed individually per staff member and schools want to ensure consistency across all users/be able to apply settings in bulk for all users.
requests.impact: Maintains consistency and cuts down on labour and training; if settings can be applied in bulk by a competent user, this is more efficient especially for schools with hundreds of staff

requests.subject: Options Completion Status Visibility
requests.details: Some students are still tagged as incomplete even though they've finished their Options. As the idea with Options is to track the status within the Options tab, and if that is the case we didn't ought to be displaying the statuses on the dashboard.
requests.impact: ensures there are no confusion on the number of students that completed the form, by having to go through the Options Tab to review the numbers rather than the dashboard area as its inconsistend with the information on options tab.

requests.subject: Adding users via the Manage user area
requests.details: When adding staff users on the manage users area and sending them an email from there - the system wouldn't show welcome email sent on the Users Area.
requests.impact: Avoids discrepancies that emails haven't been sent yet to created users.

requests.subject: Consent Description
requests.details: the consent description at the moment is confined in a small column. While you can expand it, it would be great to have a pop up text box or a way to make it bigger in the consent description where staff can easily type and at the same time review the description for each consent.
requests.impact: It will make it easier for staff to type in their description from the system itself instead of having to copy and paste it from another source.

requests.subject: Taster Day Emails
requests.details: Add an option to filter by taster day attendance or send an email from the taster day page.
requests.impact: Will allow schools to send follow up email easily to students based on their Taster Day attendance status

requests.subject: Parental consent message not included on the downloaded blank form
requests.details: After the staff downloaded the blank form for Year 7 admissions form as they need it for their GDPR inspection, the Parental Agreement and Consent section appears blank in the downloaded file. The Parental Consent message/text that should appear on that page is missing (please refer to the screenshot below). Additionally, in the Policies section at the bottom, the Data Protection message is also missing (please refer to the screenshot below). They would like the full preview to be included when the form is downloaded. According to the developer team, it is not included in the blank form.
requests.impact: This ensures the school has all necessary information for GDPR inspections and reduces the risk of delays or issues during audits.

requests.subject: Enable caps on how many can apply for each subject in GCSE Options
requests.details: We have this feature already at Year 12 and schools would appreciate the same at GCSE to limit the number of students choosing each subject and help to manage expectations.
requests.impact: Parity across systems

requests.subject: Support for Duplicate Grade Labels with Unique Point Values (WJEC vs. BTEC)
requests.details: The school needs a second distinct set of L1D, L1M, L1P for WJEC courses because the point values for these grades differ from those assigned to standard BTEC Level 1 grades.
requests.impact: allows the school to have a secondary gradeset with different point values for the same grade labels.

requests.subject: Amending meeting slots
requests.details: There's seem to be no easy way to amend a meeting slot at the moment, such as if you want to amend a staff you have to search and edit each timeslot.
requests.impact: easier to amend time slots without having to go to each slot to find the specific one they want

requests.subject: Add columns to Meetings table
requests.details: When schools are providing staff with their list of appointments, it would be useful to be able to control/add columns to the export, such as the student's form group name for internals. Perhaps adding the "view" menu to this page, so they can customise their columns (whilst leaving the core meeting details columns locked/greyed out)
requests.impact: helps staff to have all key details in one screen or export

requests.subject: Notify staff when applicant books a meeting
requests.details: When applicants choose their own meeting slots, have an option for staff to receive an automated message that notifies them that x student has booked a slot for x date and time
requests.impact: helps with tracking meeting appointments

requests.subject: Show tokens working when previewing email templates
requests.details: When previewing an email before it is sent to a student at the moment it only shows the tokens {student_first_name}, it would be good to have the preview as exactly what the student will receive including the populated merge fields e.g. Dear John instead of Dear {student_first_name}
requests.impact: it will give confidence to the school that their email template including the tokens they've set are working correctly
requests.productTeamNote: Currently being worked on new comms area update

requests.subject: UPN, ULN, UCI fields in One Reference
requests.details: In one reference we have fields for UPN, ULN and UCI but in terms of the usual core questions on a reference email in a normal A+ sixth form system, these fields aren't available in default therefore even if the schools fill these fields on OneReference, it's not connecting the field to the Reference Request made by the other schools.
requests.impact: It will align things much more properly for schools who are using the ApplicaaFutures area and normal A+ schools
requests.productTeamNote: Schools have the ability to add this fields within Reference Form under `New Questions > Custom Questions > Existing Fields.`

requests.subject: Unpublish Options for Year 12
requests.details: Once the Options for Year 12 are published, need to have an option to unpublish them if changes are needed or if they were published prematurely.
requests.impact: If there is no unpublish option, incorrect or unfinished options may be visible to students, which could cause confusion and require additional manual communication or corrections.
requests.productTeamNote:
Within the Courses Step of the application form or enrolment form, we have the ability to disable the option block view which will then hide the published options table.

*"Activate Option Block view on courses step: On/Off"*

requests.subject: PDF downloads for students
requests.details: The school wanted to add the courses the students are enrolled into on the PDF downloadable file per student
requests.impact: It will show them the details they need for audit

requests.subject: Meetings: Display interviewer on student homepage
requests.details: Currently, on the student homepage, the meeting details only show the date, time, and location. It would be helpful if there were an option to also display the interviewer’s name
requests.impact: It would benefit the students to see who will be conducting the meeting.

requests.subject: importing Meetings Time slots
requests.details: potential to explore having an option to import time slots and staff and location in the meetings area rather having to do it manually
requests.impact: would make it easier for staff to create their meetings specially for those who have multiple interviewers and multiple timeslots

requests.subject: Live Chat button
requests.details: the live chat button is positioned awkwardly, it overlaps with buttons on the bottom of the screen. The button is hard to drag around and also does not stick to where you move it and goes back to its original position when switching pages.
requests.impact: users are having to move the live chat button often as it interrupts with buttons they need to click.
requests.solution: option to hide the live chat or change its button and place it above next to helphub.

requests.subject: Add Internal vs. External Comparison for "Applications Completed" in Insights Summary
requests.details: the Insights Summary Area provides an overview of completed applications, but it lacks the ability to visualize the split between Internal and External applicants.
requests.impact: Users should be able to see at a glance how many applications were completed by internals vs. externals

requests.subject: update to information on banner
requests.details: I think the banner is showing the main phone number - support line is 0203 667 0764 so am wondering if it would be better to include that one. Is it also possible to remove the word "system" on the top line as it is redundant? The S in MIS already stands for "system".
requests.impact: Will ensure schools needing help have the direct support line.

requests.subject: Automated Opening and Closing of Forms
requests.details: At the moment, the ability to schedule when a form opens and closes is only available for Year 12. Most of the schools I work with have been asking if this can be rolled out to other forms as well so they don't have to manage it manually.
requests.impact: This would be a huge help for school staff because they could set their deadlines ahead of time and they don't have to remember to log in and manually toggle forms on or off on specific dates.

requests.subject: tooltip wording
requests.details: please can the wording of the tooltips be updated as it currently contains surplus wording. Suggest: "this step is currently visible to students"
requests.impact: would reduce confusion/make things clearer

requests.subject: BCC
requests.details: Requesting for emails to be sent using blind copy (BCC) to ensure recipients cannot view each other's email addresses.
requests.impact: Prevents recipients from viewing each other's email addresses.
requests.productTeamNote: Upon testing and checking to send an email with multiple parents copied in, the recipients does not have ability to see who else is copied in. Which means that BCC functionality is applied by default in all parent comms.

requests.subject: Add "Provider Course ID" in Exports Area
requests.details: Currently, schools can populate the "Provider Course ID". However, this field is not included when a user runs an export of students and their chosen subjects on the Exports Area.
requests.impact: This would allow schools to export a student list that includes both their chosen subjects and the corresponding 'Provider Course ID'. Schools use this field for their internal mapping codes; having it available in the export would automate their data processing and eliminate the need for manual "search and replace" tasks.

requests.subject: Built-in Video Conferencing
requests.details: Clevedon School is requesting a virtual meeting within the Admissions+ platform. The ability to conduct interviews directly within the browser/platform rather than redirecting to external links (Teams/Zoom)
requests.impact: By creating the link directly on A+, the school can manage everything in one place without relying on third-party software

requests.subject: Update wording on popup
requests.details: The current wording on this message is unclear/bad grammar. Would revise to say "You are about to clear allocated students from groups."
requests.impact: Updating the wording will make a better impression on customers and also makes the action clearer

requests.subject: Siblings Details to be added in Parent Info to be called Family Info
requests.details: Currently, sibling details are captured and displayed within the Child Education step of the Application Form, or alternatively via custom fields in the Parent/Contact details section. I believed that this information would be more useful if it were also displayed in the Student Profile Overview, similar to how Parent information is shown on that page. This would allow staff to quickly view sibling relationships without needing to navigate back to the application form.
requests.impact: Easy access of the Siblings specially if the school offers Sibling Discounts  etc.
requests.solution: Allow this to be shown as a Family Information with both parents and sibling details.

requests.subject: Dashboard Tile Filters – Parent/Carer Section
requests.details: Currently, dashboard tiles can only be built using student properties, which means it is not possible to apply filters based on Parent/Carer section responses (e.g. court orders)
requests.impact: Would allow schools to more effectively identify students based on parental information.

requests.subject: ApplicaaOne Registration
requests.details: Some schools require students to register using their school email address.
requests.impact: Would allow schools and students control over what emails they use as their main.
requests.solution: (optional):  We should have an option to either let schools or students choose whether to use school or personal email as the primary email

requests.subject: Add extra answers to hard coded field
requests.details: Would like to add 3 new options to the "who do you usually live with?" field, in order to capture income information of all contributors. Currently, if a student lives with mum/dad/both parents, it is only parental income which gets collected and used to calculate bursary band. Would like the ability to capture students' earned income as well. Propose 3 new options: Live with both parents and I am also employed, Live with parent 1 and I am also employed, Live with parent 2 and I am also employed. Link to ability to provide income details and documents for student and parent(s) in income section.
requests.impact: Allows schools to calculate household income more accurately (currently, student income is disregarded if they select an option to indicate they are living with parent(s).

requests.subject: Auto-fill name and email of referee
requests.details: Ability to add the name and email address of referee as a bulk action via One Reference, to avoid students naming the wrong person on their application forms. Schools using one reference would add the name of the referee, and students from that school who then apply to any places via ApplicaaOne would have their referee name and email address pre-filled for them.
requests.impact: Avoids students naming the wrong person on the reference section, or mistyping email address of referee. Ensures the school can nominate the correct person/people to provide the references.

requests.subject: Interested Subjects for manual destinations
requests.details: Ability to add interested subjects manually, when manually adding a destination for an applicant.
requests.impact: Useful to see what subjects they are applying for, and to be able to see this for all destinations (not just those applied for via ApplicaaOne)

requests.subject: filter/search in destination tracker
requests.details: Ability to search or filter by destination name would be useful, eg to look up all applicants who have applied to a specific place and then remind them to complete their applications (not currently possible to sort or filter on this column)
requests.impact: Makes chasing students easier for the Careers Lead of they can group/filter applications by destination

requests.subject: Wording in filter area
requests.details: I think this was missed in the recent update - all wording across the platform was changed from "interview" to "meeting", but have come across the word "interview" in the filters area
requests.impact: Lack of consistent wording may lead to confusion

requests.subject: Date/Time stamp in comms log
requests.details: we currently display the date and time of last interaction in the comms log, which causes confusion for schools. They want to see the date and time sent on the left-hand panel, and would also appreciate clearer labelling on the right side (maybe something to say date and time sent, date and time delivered, date and time(s) opened
requests.impact: Schools are confused by the current values displayed

requests.subject: Event publication to A1
requests.details: Past Events disappear from A1
requests.impact: Schools don't like that it makes the profile look unused & empty, looking like schools aren't welcoming students to the site.
requests.solution: Leave past events on the Events area, just grey them out or something so students can still tell that schools are actively hosting & welcoming them.
requests.productTeamNote:
Thank you for your suggestion regarding past events in A1. After reviewing this request, we’ve decided not to implement this change at this time. Our concern is that showing past events could confuse students, as they may expect only upcoming events to be visible.

To address the concern about empty event areas, we are exploring alternative ways to show school activity, such as displaying term dates or other relevant school information, without causing confusion. We will keep your idea in mind for future improvements where we can better highlight school activity.

requests.subject: Yr 7 ATF Import
requests.details: Feeder/ primary school details are not recorded accurately, causing future problems in the transition features. Multiple feeder schools are noted, no DfE number used & current school not ticked.
requests.impact: School has to manually go through every student & update the correct feeder school & tick that it's current
requests.solution: Use the DfE number from the csv/ATF import to apply the correct feeder school to the student profile. Also tick these as current schools for all imported students

requests.subject: First Media Import Mapping
requests.details: upon checking with Andre/devs, properties mapped from a previously successful import from First Media are not being saved and recognised for the next import at the moment and have to be manually mapped again.
requests.impact: School that uses First Media will do multiple imports through out their application process and they have to remap custom fields each time. They may also be prone to error with having to remap each field every time.
requests.solution: Allow previous mappings to be saved
requests.productTeamNote: Request is not for a feature request. Will create a customer ticket instead to have this sorted by the Devs Team. Will provide further updates whenever possible. Thanks
